## Teaching Approach

My teaching focuses on helping students connect systems engineering, data-driven methods, and real engineering decision-making. I emphasize applied problem-solving, hands-on analytical tools, and clear links between theory, modeling, and practice.

## University of South Carolina

### Applied Systems Engineering for Complex Systems, INDE 561
**Co-Lecturer, Fall 2025**

- Designed and delivered lab sessions on AI/ML and data-driven methods for systems modeling.
- Assisted in developing capstone project curriculum.
- Guided student teams through real-world engineering problem-solving.

Teaching contributions included laboratory instruction, applied examples, student project guidance, and support for course material development.

## Teaching Interests

- Applied systems engineering and complex systems.
- Smart manufacturing and industrial analytics.
